scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve an on-time State House testimony check-in while using the planned subway approach with tactile map materials.
Emerging Need: A confirmed early collection window and loaded Park Street fare remain ordinary until the next-day elevator advisory makes the usual accessible exit unreliable.
Decision Context: The useful timing depends on stored State House wayfinding notes that explain why the Bowdoin detour is risky with tactile packets and how scheduled surface assistance is prioritized.
Consequence: The scheduled surface-van advance-request route has closed. Walk-up help or other feasible transport may still reach check-in, but this reserved buffer can no longer be added.

parameter.title: State House access testimony setup
parameter.description: Tentative hold for civic-access testimony logistics; materials and exact check-in still pending.
parameter.location: Massachusetts State House, Ashburton Place accessible entrance

parameter.subject: Confirmed check-in for June 10 State House testimony
parameter.body: Your testimony logistics are confirmed for Wednesday. Committee staff will collect the tactile route-map packet at the Ashburton Place accessible entrance at 8:45 AM, before the hearing room line opens. Materials arriving after 9:05 AM may not be included in the committee packet.

parameter.description: Stored-value fare loaded for Davis-to-Park Street subway travel to the Ashburton Place testimony check-in.

parameter.subject: Park Street accessible exit work June 10 morning
parameter.body: Park Street elevator service to the Tremont/Beacon accessible exit is scheduled out of service on Wednesday, June 10, from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Riders may use the Bowdoin street detour. Scheduled surface-van assists between Park Street and Ashburton Place will be prioritized for requests received by 4:00 PM today; same-day and walk-up assistance will be limited.

parameter.content: I just passed Park Street and the accessibility notice board says tomorrow morning's scheduled van list closed at 4:00. Walk-up van board opens at 8:30 with no arrival guarantee. I am already assigned to another entrance tomorrow, so I cannot meet you before the hearing line.
